summary: Re-tested OVERLAP GUARD live UI drag fix. Discovered ROOT CAUSE: source fix in packages/roof-sketch-core/combineStructures.js was correct (Node unit test = 7/7 green) but the frontend was loading a STALE COPY from /app/frontend/node_modules/@roofspan/roof-sketch-core/combineStructures.js (pre-fix version, no Phase 2 overlap guard). Yarn's `file:../packages/roof-sketch-core` dependency creates a copy (not a symlink) and a stale webpack cache in node_modules/.cache further prevented picking up updates. After syncing the file into node_modules AND clearing the webpack cache and restarting frontend, the live UI drag now correctly pushes the small Porch fully clear of the House (interior overlap = 0). All regression checks pass.

integration_issues.issue: STALE PACKAGE COPY: /app/frontend/node_modules/@roofspan/roof-sketch-core/combineStructures.js was the pre-fix version (no Phase 2 overlap guard) even though /app/packages/roof-sketch-core/combineStructures.js contained the fix. Additionally, webpack's persistent cache in /app/frontend/node_modules/.cache further served the stale bundle. This is why iteration_78 (and the initial run of this iteration) showed the porch remaining fully contained inside the house after an extreme drag — the fix was never actually shipping to the browser.

action_items: CRITICAL: Sync updates from /app/packages/roof-sketch-core into /app/frontend/node_modules/@roofspan/roof-sketch-core after any edit. Recommended: run `cd /app/frontend && yarn install --force` after changes, OR replace the file: dependency with a symlink so edits propagate automatically. As a workaround I copied the updated combineStructures.js into node_modules and cleared node_modules/.cache.
Add a build/dev script (or postinstall hook) that copies /app/packages/roof-sketch-core/*.js into /app/frontend/node_modules/@roofspan/roof-sketch-core/ so this class of skew cannot recur.

CombinedSitePlan.jsx has react-hooks/exhaustive-deps warnings on line 25 (`offsets` logical expression could change dependencies of useMemo/useCallback every render) — wrap `offsets` in useMemo to stabilize.
Consider persisting drag offsets through the revision save flow (currently reset works but a page reload behavior wasn't tested this iteration — offsets appear to persist server-side already; ok).
critical_code_review_comments: Workspace linking gap: the frontend depends on the local package via `file:../packages/roof-sketch-core`, which yarn resolves as a copy at install time. Any subsequent edit to /app/packages/... is invisible to the running dev server unless yarn install is re-run. This is a foot-gun that will keep hiding fixes from live testing. Prefer a Yarn workspace, or a portal:/link: protocol, or a symlink.

combineStructures.js overlap guard logic itself is correct: minimal-translation to nearest side, up to 16 iterations, MIN_SEP=1ft. Node unit tests cover both the colliding side-drag and the small-inside-large cases (7/7 assertions green).
CombinedSitePlan.jsx SVG group has no interactive rect; drag relies on pointerdown on the <g>. This works but is easy to lose focus of. Confirmed live drag via dispatched PointerEvents works fine.

rca of the issue: Root cause: /app/frontend/node_modules/@roofspan/roof-sketch-core/combineStructures.js was pinned at the pre-fix version because yarn resolves `file:../packages/roof-sketch-core` as a one-time COPY at install. The Phase-2 overlap-guard block (lines 87-114 of the source) was entirely absent from the node_modules copy — diff confirmed. Webpack's persistent cache in node_modules/.cache compounded the issue. Reproduction: dragging Front Covered Porch to the House center left the porch fully contained (ix=167, iy=63). Mitigation applied here: `cp /app/packages/roof-sketch-core/combineStructures.js /app/frontend/node_modules/@roofspan/roof-sketch-core/combineStructures.js && rm -rf /app/frontend/node_modules/.cache && sudo supervisorctl restart frontend`. Permanent fix: add a postinstall/prestart sync script, convert to a Yarn workspace, or use a symlink so /app/packages/… changes propagate.
